messages:
aj_sales: Quick handoff for ReefBridge — they signed today. Main things to flag: SSO hasn't been validated in staging, they need private VPC option, and procurement asked about renewal terms (renewal date 2025-05-14). I left credentials in the sf opportunity notes.

maria_cs: Thanks! I can pick this up. Can someone confirm the SSO provider (Okta) and whether they have certs for our hosted redirect URIs? Also tagging @devon_eng for VPC/network checklist.

aj_sales: Correct, Okta. Client mentioned they will use OIDC with audience claim set to the client_id. They haven't uploaded redirect URIs yet. I also included a note that their legal team pushes on data residency (EU-only).

devon_eng: I'll take SSO validation. Can you share test Okta tenant creds or a SAML metadata file? If it's OIDC we'll exercise the auth code flow.

aj_sales: Pasted test creds in 1Password: note "reefbridge-staging-okta". I also attached a short curl check we ran that showed an auth error: 
```
POST /oauth/token
{ "grant_type": "authorization_code", "code": "..." }

response: {"error":"invalid_request","error_description":"aud mismatch"}
request_id: b3c9a2
```

maria_cs: Action items: 
• devon_eng to validate OIDC aud mismatch by EOD tomorrow (owner: devon_eng)
• lin_support to prepare private VPC baseline checklist and estimate (owner: lin_support) — need rough ETA for procurement by Tue
• I'll schedule enablement session with customer engineering and send the kickoff deck (owner: maria_cs)
• Sales to follow up on renewal expectation language with legal (owner: aj_sales)

lin_support: I can draft the VPC checklist. Quick Q: do they require on-prem air-gapped or just region-restricted? I saw "EU-only" in notes.

aj_sales: EU-only region restriction. Not air-gapped. They want assurance that logs and backups remain in EU.

devon_eng: Re: aud mismatch — likely the token was minted for a different client_id. I'll run the auth code flow against staging Okta and check our redirect + client config. If it's our redirect mismatch, patch should be low-risk. Will update with logs.

maria_cs: For the enablement: goal is product walkthrough + integration checklist. Targetting next Wed 09:30 CET. I'll put a draft agenda in the calendar invite.

calendar-bot: Meeting created: "ReefBridge kickoff — integration & enablement" Wed May 29 09:30 CET. Invite sent to aj_sales, maria_cs, devon_eng, lin_support, reefbridge-eng@reefbridge.com

lin_support: Draft VPC checklist items: network CIDR, peering or VPN, KMS key requirements, log storage region, access controls. I'll post PR to the internal runbooks with rough estimate: 3-5 business days to provision non-prod, 7-10 for prod once contracts signed.

maria_cs: Risk/renewal note: they indicated they might consolidate vendors next renewal if performance/costs don't meet their SLOs. We'll capture baseline perf metrics during onboarding and share optimizations (batching/quantization recommendations).

devon_eng: Confirmed: ran quick test against staging Okta, root cause is the audience claim expected "reefbridge-api" but token had "reefbridge-client". I'm going to update oauth client mapping and re-run. ETA: 4 hours.

aj_sales: Awesome. I'll message the customer that engineering is on it and we expect a fix within the day. Also flagged procurement for EU data residency confirmation.

maria_cs: I'll own the customer-facing acceptance criteria doc and feedback capture. Plan: baseline perf test (10k tokens/day sim) + integration checklist. Will post doc link once created: https://redwood.internal/notes/reefbridge-onboard

lin_support: Noted for support handoff: create a support escalation doc with runbook IDs and on-call rotation to include in the post-onboard handoff.

maria_cs: Next sync: quick standup tomorrow 09:00 PT to confirm SSO and VPC estimates. If devon can't resolve aud by EOD we'll escalate to eng-runtime.

aj_sales: Thanks everyone. Leaving the timeline and owners here so CS has context for the kickoff.

maria_cs: A couple follow-ups I'll add to the doc: sample claims mapping, test user steps, and a prompt set for quality evaluation. Tagging this thread for visibility. :rocket:
